note: Cases of the reference corpus where Stellarator's sandbox does not answer byte for byte as @cloudflare/codemode on workerd, grouped by cause. crates/engine/tests/conformance.rs fails on a difference that is not here and on a case here that matches.

causes.title: Engine errors whose V8 message quotes the code
causes.reason: V8 builds these messages from the source text of the failing expression or from a value (`o.go is not a function`, `r is not iterable`, `Cannot destructure property 'a' of 'undefined' as it is undefined.`, `Class constructor A cannot be invoked without 'new'`, `Invalid count value: -1`, `Invalid regular expression: /(/: Unterminated group`), or has two messages where QuickJS has one (`Assignment to constant variable.` and a read-only property; mixing BigInt and converting it). QuickJS's own message is sent. Messages with a fixed wording are V8's (js/workers-globals.js lists them).

causes.title: Code that does not parse
causes.reason: workerd answers `Failed to start Worker:\nUncaught SyntaxError: <message>\n  at executor.js:<line>:<column>`. The frame and the way the position is counted are reproduced; the message, and for some errors the position, are the parser's (QuickJS writes `expecting ';'` where V8 writes `Unexpected identifier 'x'`). TypeScript syntax is a syntax error in both.

causes.title: Error.stack
causes.reason: The first line (the error's name and message) and the form of a frame are V8's. The columns, the frames of awaited calls and the owners V8 prints before a method's name (`Proxy.<anonymous>`) are QuickJS's, and `stack` is read through Error.prototype instead of being the error's own property.

causes.title: Globals of the Workers runtime the sandbox does not define
causes.reason: Not defined, so code that uses one gets a ReferenceError (or `No such module`) where Workers runs it: Request, Response, Headers, FormData, Blob, File, WebSocket, EventSource, the streams, AbortController and AbortSignal, Event and EventTarget, URLPattern, Buffer, WebAssembly, caches, reportError, crypto.subtle and crypto.DigestStream, TextDecoder for the legacy encodings (shift_jis, gbk and the like), the `node:` modules (import() and process.getBuiltinModule) and cloudflare:sockets. fetch() of a `data:` URL is refused like every other URL.

causes.title: Intl and locales
causes.reason: Intl is not defined. toLocaleString, toLocaleDateString and toLocaleTimeString of numbers and dates write the default format (en-US, UTC) exactly; with another locale or with options they throw a TypeError that says so, where Workers (full ICU) formats. toLocaleLowerCase and toLocaleUpperCase ignore their locale.

causes.title: A result the AI SDK cannot serialize (code_tool)
causes.reason: A BigInt or a cycle in the returned value: the AI SDK throws while it writes the tool's output, the agent's request fails, and the model never gets a tool message. Stellarator sends `Error: Code execution failed: <why>` instead of failing the sample. (The runtime format answers these itself, and matches: a BigInt becomes a string.)

causes.title: Code that never yields
causes.reason: `while (true) {}`: the executor's timeout is a timer and cannot fire. workerd alone has no limit and never answers (the reference run gives up after 8 s); on Cloudflare's network the Worker's CPU limit ends it. Stellarator interrupts the code 250 ms after the timeout and answers `Execution timed out`.

causes.title: A tool called with something that is not an arguments object
causes.reason: `mock.lookup("tides")`: the MCP TypeScript client sends the string as `arguments`, and the answer is the server's (the Rust SDK's server refuses the request: `Error POSTing to endpoint: {"jsonrpc":"2.0",...,"error":{"code":-32601,...}}`). Stellarator's MCP client sends objects only and answers `The arguments of mock.lookup must be an object of the tool's parameters.`

causes.title: Earlier reasoning in the next request
causes.reason: The AI SDK's OpenAI-compatible provider sends an assistant turn's reasoning back as `reasoning_content`. Stellarator does not send earlier reasoning back in any mode (docs/tools.md, What happens during a run); the rest of the assistant message is the same.

causes.title: Behavior of the engine itself
causes.reason: A Proxy returned as the result (Workers RPC sends nothing for it; QuickJS code cannot tell a Proxy from its target, so its properties are sent); `new WeakRef({}).deref()` (QuickJS frees an unreferenced object at once); the date strings `2025-066` and `Q1 2025`, which V8 rejects and QuickJS reads.
